projections.title: Executive summary
projections.instruction: State the thesis, distinct contribution, reasoning, evidence, limitations and next decision in 300-500 words.

projections.title: 9th grade reader
projections.instruction: Adapt for a ninth-grade reader. Define technical words and preserve qualifications and dependencies. Reading level is a target, not a certified result.

projections.title: Skeptic version
projections.instruction: Reconstruct the strongest charitable argument and strongest objections. Separate declared commitments from inferences, evidence and open bridges. Do not invent concessions or dismiss theological premises merely for being theological.

projections.title: Formal version
projections.instruction: Give definitions, typed predicates, explicit assumptions, argument steps and obligations. Do not turn assumed conclusions into derived theorems. Mark unproved steps.

projections.title: SEO version
projections.instruction: Provide faithful title, description, slug, heading outline, search-intent hypotheses and article adaptation. No fabricated search-volume data or keyword rankings.

projections.title: Proof explorer
projections.instruction: Return an inspectable claim/premise/step/dependency/objection map with source line references. Formal proof status is unverified unless an actual compiler receipt is supplied.

projections.title: Citation audit
projections.instruction: Inventory actual citations, claims needing sources, quote/locator gaps and proposed verification actions. You have no browsing tool in this call. External verification must remain not_verified; do not fabricate citations or claim sources were checked.

projections.title: Literature comparison
projections.instruction: Compare only literature actually supplied in the source. Separate sourced comparison from suggested research. If no comparison corpus is supplied, state the gap; do not claim a completed literature search.

projections.title: Contradiction pass
projections.instruction: Identify candidate internal contradictions with both exact source spans, predicates, scope and conditions. Distinguish contradiction, tension, ambiguity and changed context. No finding is not proof of consistency.

projections.title: Lossless preservation
projections.instruction: LOCAL: preserve the exact original bytes and SHA-256; no model rewriting.

projections.title: AI package
projections.instruction: LOCAL: package the original, numbered source, prompt files and manifest for another AI.

projections.title: Substack projection
projections.instruction: Adapt to an engaging Substack article with title, subtitle, body, source-aware caveats and closing question. Do not publish or invent anecdotes.

projections.title: Theorem extraction
projections.instruction: Extract candidate definitions, assumptions and theorem statements with dependency IDs and proof obligations. Distinguish formalizable propositions from analogies. Do not claim Lean compilation.

projections.title: Graph nodes
projections.instruction: Extract stable source-local node IDs and typed directed candidate edges. Include source_refs and rationale. Relatedness is not support; no automatic canon promotion.

projections.title: Obsidian nodes
projections.instruction: Propose Markdown node notes and a map of content with stable source-local IDs and wikilinks. Return proposed note contents in items; do not modify the vault.

projections.title: Glossary extraction
projections.instruction: Extract terms, distinct senses, source definitions, exact references and missing definitions. Separate author definition from an explanatory paraphrase.

projections.title: Equation cards
projections.instruction: Extract equations verbatim with symbols, units if supplied, assumptions, domain, interpretation and limits. Mark unknown units and analogy versus mathematical identity; never invent an equation.

projections.title: Audio script
projections.instruction: Write a conversational audio adaptation with spoken transitions, pronunciation notes and source-faithful limits. Do not create fictional testimony.

projections.title: TTS narration
projections.instruction: Produce narration-ready text with spoken equation expansions and pronunciations, preserving the argument. This is TEXT, not a synthesized audio file.

projections.title: Video script
projections.instruction: Write a scene-based video script: narration, on-screen text and source-linked claims. Durations are estimates. Do not claim a rendered video exists.

projections.title: Visual storyboard
projections.instruction: Propose scene cards: purpose, composition, visual type, labels, source_refs and narration links. Distinguish conceptual illustration from evidence. This is a storyboard, not generated images.
